framework: ANSSI ReCyF (Référentiel Cyber France) / EU NIS2 Directive

objectives.title: Identity & Access Management (IAM) — Privileged MFA Enforcement
objectives.requirement: All privileged (admin) accounts must have Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) actively enforced.

remediation.compliant: Objective 10 satisfied. Maintain continuous monitoring of privileged sessions via AIDATACY Access Gateway.
remediation.non_compliant: Enforce hardware-backed or FIDO2 MFA for the {failed_count} identified non-compliant admin account(s) immediately using AIDATACY Access Gateway and revoke active legacy tokens.
